stories.title: Japan goes on student suicide watch as school term starts
stories.summary: Sayoko is watching her 13-year-old son more closely than he probably realises as he settles into his first year of junior high school in Yokohama. He is keeping up with his classes and is fortunate to be popular because of his sporting prowess.
